sedan.visual_identity: One specific late-2000s four-door compact sedan, steel blue-gray paint, slightly dusty hood, narrow angular headlights, silver five-spoke alloy wheels, black cloth cabin, dark dashboard, minor scuff on left rear door. Same grille, roofline, rear mirrors, plate shape and wheel design in exterior and interior shots. It is ALWAYS the same vehicle; lights can flicker or turn off only when the engine fails.

station.visual_identity: One specific isolated gas station on a moonlit highway, low concrete shop, weathered steel canopy, three narrow pump islands, warm amber tube lights, sliding glass entrance, locked glass door and separate STAFF ONLY store room. Facade and entrance geometry never change between night shots.
